summary: Frontend-only verification of two refactors: (1) standalone 'مزامنة الأوقات' toolbar button on /weekly-schedule, (2) separated 'المدة' button/modal from 'تغيير القاعة' modal in العرض الشامل. Logged in via real UI (admin/admin123), faculty كلية الشريعة والقانون. All 7 requested scenarios PASS. Found 1 real state-leak bug: stale newDuration from the duration modal is still sent by confirmRoomChange, so changing a room afterwards silently applies the previously chosen duration to a different lecture (reproduced).

ui_bugs.issue: Shared state `newDuration` is no longer reset when opening the room modal. Repro: set duration 120 on lecture A via master-duration-modal → select another lecture B (no duration) → open master-room-modal → change room → B gets ⏱120د applied silently (payload includes duration_minutes because newDuration='120' != oldDur=''). Fix: remove the duration_minutes logic from confirmRoomChange (line ~438-440) now that duration has its own modal, or reset setNewDuration('') in openRoomModal.

issues: Success banner text after saving duration is generic '✅ تم التحديث' (backend message) rather than something duration-specific; acceptable but less informative.
Toolbar in master view is dense (10+ colored buttons in two rows); minor visual noise only.

action_items: Fix duration leak in MasterScheduleView.confirmRoomChange (drop duration_minutes from the room payload or reset newDuration in openRoomModal).
critical_code_review_comments: MasterScheduleView.tsx: `newDuration` is shared between the (now separate) duration modal and the legacy room-change payload — leads to cross-lecture data mutation. Separate the state (e.g. roomModalDuration removed entirely).
weekly-schedule.tsx is still >2200 lines; consider extracting modals/toolbar.
runResyncTimes relies on window.confirm/alert (web-only); the button is correctly gated with Platform.OS === 'web'.
seed_data_creation: none new. Test mutations reverted: duration badges removed from both touched lectures; room of الفقه الإسلامي (السبت ف1 and ف2) now ق305 instead of ق202 (regression test side-effect, functionally valid).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: resync-lecture-times-btn exists once in toolbar (orange rgb(239,108,0)), standalone (no modal ancestor), visible for any selected faculty; clicking it produced alert '✅ كل أوقات المحاضرات المولدة مطابقة للفترات الحالية — لا شيء يحتاج تصحيحاً' (dialog handler required). Generate-lectures modal (generate-lectures-btn, needs section view + dept selected) no longer contains 'ولّدت محاضرات بأوقات خاطئة'. Master view: click text 'العرض الشامل' → master-edit-mode-btn → click master-entry-<id> (e.g. 6a7ceda7b288b439ac26922a = الفقه الإسلامي السبت ف1) → both master-change-duration-btn (orange) and master-change-room-btn (purple) render. Duration modal options: حسب الفترة/45/60/90/120/180; save 90 → cell shows '⏱90د'; reopen shows 90 preselected; select '' → badge removed. Room modal contains no duration select and room change works (ق202→ق305). Only defect: duration leak via confirmRoomChange (see ui_bugs).
rca_of_the_issue: openRoomModal does not reset the shared `newDuration` state, and confirmRoomChange still compares newDuration to the selected slot's duration and appends duration_minutes to the PUT payload. After using the new standalone duration modal, this stale value is applied to the next room change on a different lecture.
